﻿Call of Duty - Warzone Season 1 Clipping
TikTok and Instagram Reels
Launch date: Nov 5, 2026, 12:00
✔  You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
  WHAT TO DO
* Clip the Warzone Season 1 Trailer and the Developer Briefing from the content link.
* Post to TikTok and/or Instagram Reels.
Content link:
https://app.mediasilo.com/review/6aecbbe3d341897e31115b46
Season 1 details (blog, for extra context):
Warzone Season 1 blog on callofduty.com
⚠️ Use ONLY footage from the official content link. Other footage is rejected.
	  CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔  @callofduty  (tag on TikTok and Instagram)
✔  Season 1 out now  (caption or on-screen text)
✔  🎵 Agust D (Suga from BTS) - “Haegeum”  (song credit)
✔  #Ad  (disclosure, see FTC DISCLOSURE below)
	YOUR CHOICE
* Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the required parts.
Example caption (client text with the required parts in place):
Season 1 marks a major update to Call of Duty: Warzone as the free-to-play combat experience becomes fully integrated with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Deploy to Hajin and Zodiac, play with new gear like the Zipline Launcher and Grabber Drone, buff your Operator with new Elite Perks, and more. Season 1 out now.
@callofduty
🎵 Agust D (Suga from BTS) - “Haegeum”
#Ad
	* Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
* Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
* Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
  FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post must include one of these in the caption:
#Ad     #Advertisement     #Sponsored
* Put it on its own line.
* Make it the first hashtag after your caption text.
* You can add up to 3 more hashtags about the content.
* Use the same font, size, and color as your caption.
  LOGO WATERMARK (REQUIRED)
* Add the official Warzone logo to every clip.
* Keep it clear and easy to see.
Logo download: https://f.io/NsqLMqR0 
	  ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
* Use one of these lines, or write your own close to them.
* Your text should match what is in your clip.
Example lines:
* Call of Duty: Warzone gets two new maps Hajin and Zodiac in Season 1
* New Call of Duty: Warzone Season Comes to Korea in Season 1
* The new Call of Duty: Warzone look insane
	Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
  EDITING GUIDELINES
* Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use the original audio from the official assets only.
* No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
* The trailer song is already in the footage. Do not add it as a separate sound.
  REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔  English content only
✔  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔  Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔  Page audience should be mostly Tier 1-2 countries (30%+ Tier 3 may be removed)
✔  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
  NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Footage not from the official content link
❌  Posts missing #Ad, #Advertisement, or #Sponsored
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Mislabeling the content (a trailer is not "gameplay")
❌  Any added music
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not the client. We manage this campaign and are here to help.
